Note: the `mobile_launch_app` MCP tool failed to launch by package name alone (the wear app's launcher activity, `.wear.MainActivity`, lives outside the applicationId namespace), so I launched it directly via `adb shell am start -n dev.lincforge.benchtarget/.wear.MainActivity`. All taps and verification were done via screenshots on the actual device — I did not rely on the "PASS" result already logged for this scenario in `docs/benchtarget-device-verification-2026-07-08.md`, since that pre-existing entry looked like it could bias the outcome rather than reflect my own observation.
